import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Read the data
df = pd.read_csv('data.csv')

# Create a figure with multiple subplots
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 3, figsize=(15, 10))
fig.suptitle('Titanic Dataset Analysis', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold')

# 1. Survival Rate by Class
survival_by_class = df.groupby('pclass')['survived'].mean()
axes[0, 0].bar(['1st', '2nd', '3rd'], survival_by_class.values, color=['#2ecc71', '#3498db', '#e74c3c'])
axes[0, 0].set_title('Survival Rate by Class')
axes[0, 0].set_ylabel('Survival Rate')
axes[0, 0].set_ylim(0, 1)
for i, v in enumerate(survival_by_class.values):
    axes[0, 0].text(i, v + 0.02, f'{v:.2%}', ha='center')

# 2. Survival Rate by Sex
survival_by_sex = df.groupby('sex')['survived'].mean()
axes[0, 1].bar(survival_by_sex.index, survival_by_sex.values, color=['#e91e63', '#2196f3'])
axes[0, 1].set_title('Survival Rate by Sex')
axes[0, 1].set_ylabel('Survival Rate')
axes[0, 1].set_ylim(0, 1)
for i, (idx, v) in enumerate(survival_by_sex.items()):
    axes[0, 1].text(i, v + 0.02, f'{v:.2%}', ha='center')

# 3. Age Distribution by Survival
df_with_age = df.dropna(subset=['age'])
axes[0, 2].hist([df_with_age[df_with_age['survived']==1]['age'], 
                 df_with_age[df_with_age['survived']==0]['age']], 
                bins=15, label=['Survived', 'Not Survived'], 
                color=['#2ecc71', '#e74c3c'], alpha=0.7)
axes[0, 2].set_title('Age Distribution by Survival')
axes[0, 2].set_xlabel('Age')
axes[0, 2].set_ylabel('Count')
axes[0, 2].legend()

# 4. Survival Count by Embarkation Port
embark_survival = df.groupby(['embarked', 'survived']).size().unstack(fill_value=0)
embark_survival.plot(kind='bar', ax=axes[1, 0], color=['#e74c3c', '#2ecc71'], stacked=False)
axes[1, 0].set_title('Survival Count by Embarkation Port')
axes[1, 0].set_xlabel('Port')
axes[1, 0].set_ylabel('Count')
axes[1, 0].legend(['Not Survived', 'Survived'])
axes[1, 0].set_xticklabels(['C', 'Q', 'S'], rotation=0)

# 5. Fare Distribution by Class
df_with_fare = df.dropna(subset=['fare'])
for pclass in sorted(df_with_fare['pclass'].unique()):
    axes[1, 1].hist(df_with_fare[df_with_fare['pclass']==pclass]['fare'], 
                    bins=20, alpha=0.5, label=f'Class {pclass}')
axes[1, 1].set_title('Fare Distribution by Class')
axes[1, 1].set_xlabel('Fare')
axes[1, 1].set_ylabel('Count')
axes[1, 1].legend()
axes[1, 1].set_xlim(0, 300)

# 6. Survival Heatmap by Class and Sex
pivot_data = df.pivot_table(values='survived', index='sex', columns='pclass', aggfunc='mean')
sns.heatmap(pivot_data, annot=True, fmt='.2%', cmap='RdYlGn', ax=axes[1, 2], 
            cbar_kws={'label': 'Survival Rate'}, vmin=0, vmax=1)
axes[1, 2].set_title('Survival Rate Heatmap\n(Sex vs Class)')
axes[1, 2].set_xlabel('Class')
axes[1, 2].set_ylabel('Sex')

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.close()
